alignment_floor_note: Measured on the 2,000-card Finnish Speech harvest: 106,115 of 126,581 candidates remain eligible, every card retains at least 12 examples, and the release fills exactly 10 examples per card. The shared 0.30 floor admitted low-alignment duplicates and produced a one-example release shortfall.
policy_note: Finnish letters, including ä, ö and å, remain distinct under NFC normalization. Apostrophes can mark a morpheme or syllable boundary and hyphens occur in compounds and foreign-name inflection, so neither is rejected globally. Compound and colon-inflection behaviour remains an explicit first-run audit item.
